tier_should.rationale: Unique 23-year RCT follow-up shows sizeable intergenerational child-mortality gains from deworming; design credible, analysis thorough though mediation exploratory. Contribution substantial for health-dev economics, likely meets top field standards.

tier_will.rationale: High-profile authors, NBER WP, policy relevance, solid causal evidence; despite prior deworming debate, paper likely placed in AER/AEJ or similar elite outlet.
